lede: Penn State carries the stronger underlying team rating — +4.6 against +2.2, a 2.4-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Penn State -19.0 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Penn State winning 90% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is special teams, where Wisconsin leads Penn State by 95 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 79% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
